title: Linearized 2-Simplicial Attention
abstract: arXiv:2608.09307v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We present a linearized form of 2-simplicial attention by rewriting the trilinear score as an inner product between a composite query and a key, so that the sum over keys takes the same form as ordinary softmax attention. We then approximate this sum with positive random features and store all previous keys in a fixed-size state, while the sum over second keys stays exact over all previous tokens. This reduces the cost from cubic to quadratic in sequence length, and both keys range over all previous tokens, which windowed 2-simplicial attention does not allow. We implement it with custom Triton kernels and combine it with Kimi Delta Attention to build a model with no softmax attention at all. With 15B equal training tokens on FineWeb-Edu, this model lowers validation loss from 2.35 to 2.32 over a KDA hybrid and lowers LAMBADA perplexity from 40 to 38.

translated_title: 线性化的2-单纯形注意力
translated_abstract: 我们通过将三线性得分改写为复合查询与键之间的内积，提出了一种线性化的2-单纯形注意力形式，使得对键的求和具有与普通softmax注意力相同的形式。随后我们用正随机特征近似这一求和，并将所有先前的键存储在固定大小的状态中，而对第二个键的求和在所有先前token上保持精确。这将计算成本从关于序列长度的三次方降低到二次方，且两个键都能覆盖所有先前的token，这是窗口化的2-单纯形注意力所无法实现的。我们使用自定义Triton内核实现了该方法，并将其与Kimi Delta Attention结合，构建了一个完全不使用softmax注意力的模型。在FineWeb-Edu上使用150亿等量训练token进行训练时，该模型相比KDA混合模型将验证损失从2.35降至2.32，并将LAMBADA困惑度从40降至38。
tldr: 该论文提出线性化2-单纯形注意力，通过将三线性得分改写为内积并用正随机特征近似，将计算成本从三次方降至二次方，并与Kimi Delta Attention结合构建了完全无softmax注意力的模型，在验证损失和困惑度上均优于KDA混合模型。
